overview: The Cabins at Fort Wilderness are Disney Vacation Club cabins tucked into the woods of Fort Wilderness, a quiet, outdoorsy alternative to a hotel room.
suits: Families who want a private cabin in the woods with a boat to Magic Kingdom.
rooms: Each cabin sleeps up to six and has a full kitchen, a deck and a separate bedroom. You don't need to be a member to stay.
pools: Guests use the Fort Wilderness pools, including the Meadow Swimmin' Pool.
dining: Trail's End Restaurant is nearby, and the Hoop-Dee-Doo Musical Revue dinner show plays at Pioneer Hall.
pros: Private cabin with a kitchen and deck
cons: Internal buses or a golf cart are needed to get around
Buses to every park except Magic Kingdom
Fewer on-site amenities than a hotel
tips: Rent a golf cart to get around Fort Wilderness.
Catch the free campfire and outdoor movie in the evening.
bestFor: Families who want a cabin in the woods.
